prompt:
One panel of a wordless five-panel story sequence for a mystery adventure video game.

Scene: the same garage later in the night, seen from very low near the concrete floor. In the foreground, the old hydraulic bottle jack: a thin trickle of dark oil runs down its side into a black puddle spreading across the concrete, drawn in black ink with a single cold pale mint highlight of the work-lamp light glinting on the oil surface (the spot colour, the ONLY colour). Behind it, the side of the car has sunk much lower than before; under the car's side sill, two white sneakers rest motionless on the cardboard. No blood, no injury, nothing graphic, only the sunken car, the oil and the still sneakers. Nobody else is in the garage: NO standing person, NO figure, NO silhouette anywhere in the picture (it is the middle of the night and she is alone).

Objects to draw accurately when they appear: an old 1980s boxy compact sedan; a small old hydraulic bottle jack (a short upright cylinder with a pump lever socket) under the side of the car, with no jack stands anywhere; a garage with a concrete floor, a roller shutter door, a wooden workbench with hand tools, and a clamp-on work lamp.

Format: ONE single wordless (silent) manga / graphic-novel panel that fills the whole canvas edge to edge: full bleed, no panel border, no gutter, no multi-panel page layout. Art style: bold confident black ink brush and pen linework, crisp cross-hatching and printed dot screentone (halftone) for all greys and shadows, on warm off-white paper (#F2EAD8). STRICTLY MONOCHROME: everything is black ink and neutral grey screentone on the cream paper EXCEPT for ONE single spot accent colour, pale dawn mint green (#5EE6B4), used sparingly only where the scene says. No other hue anywhere: no skin tones, no blue sky, no red, no brown oil, no wood colours, no car paint colour outside the spot colour. Clear, readable composition, strong silhouettes, deep blacks, quiet, cold and gently mysterious mood, respectful and non-graphic, never scary. People are drawn from behind or as silhouettes, or only their legs or hands; faces are NEVER shown, no front or three-quarter view of anyone's face. Premium published graphic-novel quality.

ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT OF ANY KIND ANYWHERE: no lettering, no speech balloons, no thought bubbles, no caption boxes, no narration boxes, no sound-effect lettering or onomatopoeia (neither Japanese kana/kanji nor Latin letters), no numbers or numerals (clocks, screens and dials are blank), no signs or signage, no labels, no brand names, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no panel number. Use only pictures, lines, tone and light. NO gore, NO blood, NO wounds, NO injuries shown, NO dead bodies, NO nudity, NO bare skin beyond hands, NO frightening faces.
